purpose: Production binding and state-transition contract that turns the Dallas event-resolution rules from gamecast-integration-01 into deterministic Gamecast animation selections while remaining runtime-neutral in this batch.

bindingContract.teamIsolation: Reject any player binding whose canonical roster team is not DAL.

transitionPolicy.newPlay: Clear transient animation, signature, possession-transfer and impact state before selecting the first event for the new playKey.
transitionPolicy.samePlay: Blend only between actions belonging to the same canonical player unless the event explicitly transfers possession or identifies a second participant.
transitionPolicy.repeatedEvent: Do not restart an identical animation for the same player/event fingerprint while it is already active.
transitionPolicy.outOfOrderEvent: Ignore an event whose sequence/timestamp precedes the accepted state for the current playKey unless marked as an authoritative correction.
transitionPolicy.authoritativeCorrection: Reset transient state for the corrected play and resolve again from the corrected event payload.
transitionPolicy.playEnd: Blend to player idle/base, release transient ball ownership, and return root motion to the locked bottom-center foot anchor.
transitionPolicy.gameChange: Destroy Dallas transient bindings before resolving a different game; never carry animation state across games.

possessionPolicy.visualRule: The football remains attached to the established possession hand/socket until an explicit transfer or release event; animation fallback must not duplicate or teleport the ball.

signaturePolicy.guard: No other player or event may receive a named signature unless a later verified signature manifest explicitly adds it.

renderInvariants.appearanceAuthority: current official headshot lock stored by the Dallas appearance-reference phase; never infer appearance from name
renderInvariants.scale: player-specific locked scale; no action-driven rescaling
renderInvariants.footAnchor: bottom-center between planted feet; root motion returns here
renderInvariants.uniformNumber: roster.json current number; invariant across base/action/signature assets

fallbackPolicy.missingFile: Continue down fallback order without blanking the scene.
fallbackPolicy.unknownPlayer: Do not substitute a similarly named Dallas player; retain existing non-chibi Gamecast presentation.
fallbackPolicy.unknownEvent: Prefer idle/base only for a resolved Dallas player; otherwise retain existing non-chibi Gamecast presentation.

checks: All animation selection remains filtered by roster.json action inventory.
Named signatures are limited to the two verified Dallas routes already approved.
Repeated polling cannot continuously restart the same animation fingerprint.
New-play, game-change, and authoritative-correction paths clear stale transient state.
Possession continuity survives action fallback without ball duplication.
Missing assets fail soft and never blank Gamecast.
Cross-team identity collisions cannot resolve into Dallas assets.
No MLB or NHL renderer, selector, state path, or asset is referenced or changed by this contract.
